notes: Scored 13 concerns (C2-C4, C6, C8-C16); C1, C5, C7, C17 excluded as presentation. Per referee.json match_note, round 1 matches arXiv v1 and the v1 text has none of the requested fixes (no 30 degree device, no D6 diode data, no switching histograms, single 20 K phase dataset), so fixed_in_v1 is false throughout. A covers far more: 8 raised, 3 partly, 2 not raised (C12 switching-current fluctuations, C15 diode-to-phase-switching link). B: 2 raised (C8, C14), 4 partly, 7 not raised; B says nothing on the inductance/stiffness analysis (C2-C4), inhomogeneity (C9) or co-tunneling consistency (C16). C2 for A is judged raised because A names the exact Is2>>Is1 vs 3:1 conflict, though only as a minor point. A's kinetic-inductance estimate (2.8) overlaps excluded C1 and is not listed as extra. B's C13 partly rests on its vortex alternative, which is also its C8 match. Both reviews independently raise field-zero offset as an explanation for the zero-field diode and inductance-induced harmonics, which no referee raised.
